content: Ẹmmaana cha Mosẹs
Wa ojinọng wani kw'efona cha Lẹvi, ọtza ọtzọkha kwanọng kw'efona cha Lẹvi k'ọbada.
Wa kwanọng nwa otzima ibhọr, ọmaan ojinọng. Mada ore bi, nnwa nwa ojibh-ojibh, odubh-ẹ k'aphe attaan.

Mada ọnẹ-ẹ dọk ofha odubha, ọtzọkha nnwa nwa okhe k'ikhiriba s'otzim ettimma osi. Otzima ẹbaanttim ọkpa aphaangi p'ikhiriba nna. Ọtzọkha ikhiriba nna, ttara nnwa k'ẹtzaanga, ọnana k'araraari p'ameni k'asi, p'awobh k'ẹraangakha ch'ọraanga kwa Nile.
Ọgbaanọkka kw'ikwanọng kwa nnwa nwa ọtza ọpaangi obe, ifha ore ọttọhk f'osi nnwa nwa.

Wa nnwa kwa Phero kw'ikwanọng otzima aminava p'ade atzọhmnọng pẹ ọtza bi, otza ogbobha asi k'ọraanga kwa Nile. Mada aminava mba am-arenga m'ẹraangakha, nnwa kwa Phero on-ore ikhiriba k'ottem kw'araraari p'ameni k'ẹraangakha, ọtzọhm ọtzọhmnọng wani kwẹ bi, ọtza ọtzọkha sẹ otzima okwu.
Mada ogwong sẹ, ore nnwa k'ẹtzaanga kw'om-obhom ẹmọng. Ọkhaama nkwu-osisi ọmaan-ẹ. Oben bi, “Nnwa nwa ofha ode oHiburu-nwa wani.”
Mẹ wọ, ọgbaanọkka kwa nnwa nwa ọbọbh nnwa kwa Phero kw'ikwanọng bi, “Na mfha nda nyeri oHiburu-kwanọng wani, kw'ọfha ọrọk nnwa nwa ọnang-ọ o?”
Nnwa kwa Phero oben ọgbaanọkka kwa nnwa nwa bi, “Ojibhi kẹ, rọhng!” Mẹ wọ, otza otzima ọkka kwa nnwa nwa okwu.
Nnwa kwa Phero oben ọkka kwa nnwa nwa bi, “Kọ tzọkha nnwa nwa arọk anang-m. Kaam ńnang-ọ agbukha k'ọtzọhm fọ.” Mẹ wọ, ọkka kwa nnwa nwa ọtzọkh-ẹ ọrọk.
K'ogbe kwa nnwa nwa ọkk'ọn-ọbara, ọtzọkh-ẹ ochena nnwa kwa Phero kw'on-ode ọkka kwa nnwa nwa. Ọkpẹ-ẹ Mosẹs
, oben bi, “Nwong nnwa nwa k'asi.”
Mosẹs ọrọbh ochina Midiyan

Iwa ewu dani, k'ogbe kw'iwa Mosẹs ọkk'ọn-ọbara, wa ofon otza odibh anọng pẹ p'Israẹl. Ore ọtzọhm gaang-agaang f'ihem f'anọng pẹ am-asi, obiro ore da ojinọng wani kw'ofon Ijip om-ottum oHiburu-jinọng, kw'ode obhon-nọng kwa kẹ Mosẹs.
Mada Mosẹs ọbhakhi okkeri, ọnọng kore, ofhu ojinọng nwa kw'ofon Ijip, ọtzọkha obukhi kwẹ ọnọhnga k'oyeyeng.
K'ewu ch'ejem mẹ, Mosẹs on-oyin k'iyaan, otza ore aHiburu-jinọng afa p'am-arima erima, ọbọbh oyok kw'aponga apyibhi bi, “Areng mbọng afẹ am-attum oyokh-oyok o?”

Ojinọng nwa obhin-ẹ bi, “Anyi wọ ọsọ-ọ oho ọmaana ọttọhn-aponga kwaman o? Am-asi achibhi bi abira afhu-m mach'afhu oJipnọng o?” Mẹ wọ, ojora ọnwa Mosẹs, on-ochibhi bi, “K'odik-ọkka odik nwa ọkk'ọjaakh e.”
Mada Phero ọbhaang odik nwa, oror nden s'otzima ofhu Mosẹs. Ofona mẹ, Mosẹs ọrọbh ka Phero k'itzitzikha otza oruk ka Midiyan, otza owobha ẹwọr ọbaanga esipe dani.
Wa ọkhaam ọfọhnẹja wani kwa Midiyan, kw'iwa ọkhaam va p'ipanọng azenamfa. Ewu dani, aminava mba azenamfa akwu akhaabha asi k'esipe akhe k'ọgbaakha, ifha bẹ anang etzirakpo py'otte kwabẹ.
Yina, akker-arukhimaan bani akwu akhubh aminava mba, mẹ wọ, Mosẹs obina bi bik ọtza ọkkaana bẹ, ọnang etzirakpo pyabẹ asi.
Mada aminava mba abhan, otte kwabẹ kw'okpen Reuẹl ọbọbh bẹ bi, “Kaambi bọng akk'ẹbhar-ẹbhar akhuna. Ode yan mayina?”
Bẹ abhin-ẹ bi, “Ọnọng wani kw'ofon Ijip wọ ọkkaan man ka mbọhk s'akker-arukhimaan, obiro ọkkaana ọnang etzirakpo pyaman asi.”
Reuẹl ọbọbh aminava pẹ bi, “Bọng asi yan afona ajẹ ẹ? Bọng nọhng atza ayer-ẹ okwu ochi ọttọhk.”
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs okhera bi, okwu oruk k'ọhọhm kwa Reuẹl. Wa Reuẹl okwu ọtzọkha ominanwa wani kwẹ kw'okpen Zipọra, ọnang Mosẹs k'ọbada.
Zipọra ọmaan Mosẹs nnwa kw'ijinọng, Mosẹs ọkpẹ-ẹ Gẹrshọm, oben bi, “Kaam nkk'okhekhen-nọng nna nda m'okhekhen-mon nwa.”
Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaang ẹmọng ch'anọng p'Israẹl

M'ogbe-bhirada nwuma, ọvaarnọng kw'Ijip okwu ope. Anọng p'Israẹl abhom ẹmọng ch'ẹkkaana anang Ibinọkpaabyi, okhuri ebira cha bẹ awobh k'Ijip. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga ẹmọng chabẹ, cha bẹ abhomi k'ihem.
Wa Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga ẹmọng chabẹ, obiro ojima echekhi ch'ọkhaam ttara Abraham mọgbakha Isaak, ọmaana Jekọb.
Wa Ibinọkpaabyi ore bi, anọng p'Israẹl awobh k'ihem, on-obiro ọkpakh-ẹ bi, ọkkaana bẹ.

footnotes.text: 2.10 K'eHiburu, che cha Mosẹs ekheri ọwọnhg kwa “ẹtzọra atzima ayin k'iyaan.”
